items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Four subcommands, fix list 1-6 (item 3 effective-policy sub-point rebutted), F1a/F1b/F4/F6/F10/F7, A9/B1/B4 built; inventory.json left as planned (coverage.py frozen).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every chain stops at the first failing tool and names its reason; close-phase fails closed without run state or release commit.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: argv lists, no shell; --from and --phase-task-id validated; SHA-256 for run ids.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: L1 injected-runner tests, real git and gh stub decision tests on both drivers, seeded regression through the CLI driver; 460+ tests green.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops over unbounded input; one git/uv call per step.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: One lib module per subcommand, each under 300 lines; new tests in new files.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: release_run.json, release_state.json, phase_history and the golden traces round-trip through real git in test_p4_decisions.py.
